title: Global Warming

Global Warming: 
The Earth's temperature is rising due to bad things people do. Burning fossil fuels and cutting trees release bad gases, trapping heat. This hurts our planet, causing super hot summers and really cold winters. It also melts ice and makes sea levels rise, which can flood cities. We can help by using less energy, planting trees, and not wasting water. Every small action we take can make a big difference to save our planet.

title: Python
content: Python is a fun programming language. It's easy to learn and use. Python is used for websites, games, and apps. You can write code using words and symbols. It's like writing a recipe for your computer. Python is great for beginners and experts. You can use it to make cool projects like chatbots, quizzes, and animations. Start with basic concepts like variables, loops, and functions, and you'll be coding like a pro in no time.
